preconditions.description: The number of members is between 3 and 150,000.
The number of pairs of friends is less than the total possible pairs.
Each member is numbered between 1 and n.
No member is a friend with themselves.

preconditions.expression: Each pair (ai, bi) appears at most once
preconditions.description: Each pair of members is listed only once.

invariants.expression: all(ai in range(1, n + 1) and bi in range(1, n + 1) for ai, bi in friend_pairs)
invariants.description: All friend pairs are within the range of member numbers.

invariants.expression: all(ai != bi for ai, bi in friend_pairs)
invariants.description: No member is a friend with themselves.

invariants.expression: all(ai != bi for ai, bi in combinations(range(1, n + 1), 2) if (ai, bi) not in friend_pairs and (bi, ai) not in friend_pairs)
invariants.description: All possible pairs of members that are not friends are not listed.

invariants.expression: all(all(ai in friends_of[bi] for ai in friends_of[bi]) and all(bi in friends_of[ai] for bi in friends_of[ai]) for ai, friends_of in friends_of_members.items())
invariants.description: Each member's friends list is symmetric.

invariants.expression: all(all(ai in friends_of[bi] and bi in friends_of[ai] for ai, bi in combinations(range(1, n + 1), 2) if (ai, bi) not in friend_pairs and (bi, ai) not in friend_pairs) for bi, friends_of in friends_of_members.items())
invariants.description: All possible pairs of members that are not friends are not listed in any member's friends list.

invariants.expression: all(all(ai in friends_of[bi] and bi in friends_of[ai] and ai in friends_of[cj] and cj in friends_of[ai] and bi in friends_of[cj] and cj in friends_of[bi] for ai, bi in friend_pairs for cj in range(1, n + 1) if cj != ai and cj != bi) for bi, friends_of in friends_of_members.items())
invariants.description: For every three distinct members (X, Y, Z), if X-Y and Y-Z then also X-Z.
